description: Implementation of the IpcServer, including socket management, message processing, and RPC handling within the Rialto IPC framework.

classes.name: ServerImpl
classes.description: Core server implementation managing sockets, client connections, message processing, and RPC calls within the Rialto IPC framework.

classes.name: ClientImpl
classes.description: Represents a connected client, managing its credentials and associated services.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Controls server-side RPC call handling, including serial ID tracking and failure states.

classes.name: FileDescriptor
classes.description: Wrapper for file descriptors to ensure safe management and automatic closing.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Represents a listening socket, including its path, file descriptor, and connection callbacks.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to the server factory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ServerImpl instance.

methods.name: ServerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing epoll and eventfd, setting up the server's main event loop.

methods.name: ~ServerImpl
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up sockets, epoll, and eventfd resources.

methods.name: getSocketLock
methods.description: Creates and locks a socket lock file to prevent multiple server instances.

methods.name: closeListeningSocket
methods.description: Closes and removes a listening socket and its lock file.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Adds a new UNIX domain socket to listen for incoming client connections, with connection callbacks.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds an existing socket as a client connection, duplicating and configuring the socket.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the epoll file descriptor used for event polling.

methods.name: wakeEventLoop
methods.description: Wakes the main event loop by writing to the eventfd.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes pending epoll events, handling new connections, client messages, and cleanup.

methods.name: processNewConnection
methods.description: Accepts a new client connection on a listening socket and adds it to the client list.

methods.name: processClientSocket
methods.description: Handles incoming data or errors on a client socket, including message parsing and disconnection.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a message to a client if still connected.

methods.name: sendErrorReply
methods.description: Sends an error message back to a client.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles the completion of an RPC call, sending back the response or error.
